# AuraScribe

> Free, open-source, 100% offline voice dictation for Windows. Press a hotkey, speak, and clean
> punctuated text is typed into any application. Every word is transcribed on the user's own PC,
> so nothing is sent to the cloud. No account, no subscription. MIT licensed.

## What it is
- On-device (offline) speech-to-text for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).
- Global hotkey (default Ctrl+Shift+Space) dictates into whatever app has the cursor.
- Installer is about 8.6 MB; runs faster than real time on an ordinary CPU.
- Automatic local cleanup: punctuation, capitalisation, and filler-word removal.
- A private, local alternative to Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Dragon, and Windows Voice Typing.

## Languages and engines (all on-device)
- English — Moonshine (Useful Sensors).
- 25 European languages — NVIDIA Parakeet TDT.
- ~40 Asian languages — Dolphin (DataoceanAI, Tsinghua).
- Malayalam and Kannada — IndicConformer (AI4Bharat).
- Inference runs on sherpa-onnx (k2-fsa) and ONNX Runtime; the app shell is Tauri.

## Privacy
- The only network request the app ever makes is downloading a speech model once.
- No telemetry, no analytics, no account.

## Author
Jeswin Thomas Jestin — creator and maintainer of AuraScribe. He designed and built the whole app:
the local-first architecture, the four on-device speech engines (Moonshine, NVIDIA Parakeet, Dolphin,
and AI4Bharat's IndicConformer), the on-device cleanup pipeline, and the Windows text injection. He
also packaged and contributed a Malayalam speech model back to the open-source speech community.
